portal_description:
The K Desktop Environment (KDE) is a graphical desktop environment for the X Window System. The kdelibs packages include core libraries for the K Desktop Environment.

The attica packages provide a Qt library that implements the Open Collaboration Services API version 1.4.

BlueDevil is a set of components that integrate Bluetooth in KDE.

The libbluedevil packages provide a Qt-based library aimed at handling Bluetooth functionality.

The kde-workspace packages have been upgraded to upstream version 4.14.8, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. (BZ#1026809)

The attica packages have been upgraded to upstream version 0.4.2, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. (BZ#1026809)

The bluedevil and libbluedevil packages have been upgraded to upstream version 2.1, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. (BZ#1026809)

The qt packages have been updated to ensure correct operation on Power little endian or ARM 64-bit hardware architectures. (BZ#1125662)

Users of KDE are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and add these enhancements. The desktop must be restarted (log out, then log back in) for this update to take effect.
